title: Australian house prices expected to rise at least 5% in 2026 after jump last year
summary: While last year’s 8.6% increase isn’t likely to be repeated, economists expect growth across the country as demand continues to outstrip supply Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australian residential property values are expected to rise by at least 5% over the next 12 months – on top of the 8.6% increase seen in 2025 – exacerbating a housing affordability crunch across the country.
